claim: The written workflow cannot pass on a private GitHub repository: Checkout sets persist-credentials: false, so the next step 'git fetch --no-tags --update-head-ok origin +refs/heads/*:refs/heads/*' goes to the network without credentials and the job fails before stapel check. Not promised does not exclude private repositories. Fix without the network: fetch-depth 0 already brings every branch as refs/remotes/origin/*, so the local branches can come from a local fetch of those refs. Also reported by the reviewer (R-1, MEDIUM).
